item.title: BSU PROGRAMS UNDERGO AACCUP EVALUATION FOR LEVEL 4 - Benguet State University
item.description: 10-12 March 2026 Four of Benguet State University’s (BSU) degree programs were evaluated for Level IV status by the Accrediting Agency of Chartered Colleges and Universities in the Philippines (AACCUP) during the hybrid survey visit. The Accreditation Team was headed by Carlo F. Vadil from Nueva Vizcaya State University (NVSU), who joined the evaluation onsite.
